title: Titanium Linkage Pivot Bolt
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (Grade 5, UNS R56400) was selected for this suspension hardware application because its 900+ MPa tensile enables thin-wall lightweighting under cyclic loading. The alpha-beta microstructure provides 45% higher specific strength than 4140 steel, critical for weight-sensitive designs. Its 6.7 W/mK thermal conductivity simplifies thermal management. This rationale is driven by suspension linkage pivot bolt set and fat life requirements.
process: CNC turning Swiss-type for suspension hardware geometry
Thread rolling DIN 13-1 6g with SPC sampling
Go/No-Go ring gauging with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Bead blasting 120 grit Al2O3 for matte finish Ra 1.6-3.2um followed by passive oxide stabilization in DI water — tailored for suspension linkage pivot application
commonFailures: Fatigue failure at head tube junction - mitigated by smooth weld radius >=5mm + post-weld shot peening — critical for suspension linkage pivot performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Linkage Pivot Bolt suitable for Suspension linkage pivot bolt set?
faq.a: Titanium Linkage Pivot Bolt uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address suspension hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Linkage Pivot Bolt?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Linkage Pivot Bolt is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for suspension linkage pivot requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Linkage Pivot Bolt require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. suspension linkage pivot components require Bead blasting 120 grit Al2O3 for matte finish Ra 1.6-3.2um followed by passive oxide stabilization in DI water — tailored for suspension linkage pivot application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Linkage Pivot Bolt shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Linkage Pivot Bolt includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet suspension linkage pivot specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Linkage bolt / Pivot screw suspension hardware components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
